Product Details: The Xtra Power TCT Saw Blade is a versatile and reliable cutting tool designed for both professional tradespeople and DIY enthusiasts. Available in three sizes — 4 inch, 5 inch, and 6 inch — and with tooth configurations of 30, 40, and 60 teeth, this pack of 5 blades offers exceptional flexibility for a wide range of cutting applications. The Tungsten Carbide Tipped (TCT) construction ensures superior hardness and long-lasting sharpness, making these blades well-suited for cutting through wood, plywood, laminates, and other similar materials with precision and ease. The varying tooth counts allow you to choose the right blade for the job — fewer teeth for faster, rougher cuts and more teeth for smoother, finer finishes. The sturdy build quality of these blades ensures minimal vibration during operation, resulting in cleaner cuts and improved control. Whether you are working on a construction site or a home workshop project, the Xtra Power TCT Saw Blades deliver consistent performance and durability. The pack of 5 ensures you always have a spare blade ready, making it a practical and efficient choice for regular use.
